explanations.title: Parse supported review commands
explanations.summary: Only a supported command on the first non-empty line is accepted: `review`, `ignore`, `why`, or `explain <path>`. Explain paths that are absolute or escape the repository are rejected.

explanations.title: Require repository write access
explanations.summary: A parsed command is returned only when GitHub confirms the commenter has write, maintain, or admin permission. Permission lookup failures and insufficient access are rejected.
